{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_rankgap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Instead of using margin-based or log-sigmoid losses on log-probability differences, this loss emphasizes ranking consistency by applying a tanh-based smoothed penalty on the rank gap modulated by the advantage signal. It encourages models to respect both the rank order and the advantage magnitude in a stable, differentiable manner.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(batch['log_prob_w'], batch['log_prob_l'])\nadv_w = batch['advantage_w']\nadv_l = batch['advantage_l']\nadv_diff = adv_w - adv_l\nscore = tanh(alpha * rank_gap * adv_diff)\nloss = (1 - score) * weight\nfinal_loss = mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "rank_gap",
    "tanh",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    gap = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    scaled = ops.mul(ops.mul(alpha, gap), adv_diff)\n    score = ops.tanh(scaled)\n    loss = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(score), score), weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_weighted_sum",
  "intuition": "pairwise logsigmoid loss with weighted sum aggregation instead of mean",
  "pseudocode": "x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * (cost_b - cost_a)\nloss = -logsigmoid(clamp(x, -20, 20))\nif weight:\n  loss = loss * weight\nfinal_loss = sum(loss) / sum(weight) if weight else sum(loss)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_loss = loss * weight\n        total_weight = ops.sum(weight)\n        return ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.clamp(total_weight, 1e-8, 1e8))\n    else:\n        return ops.sum(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rank_gap_squared_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from pairwise margin logistic loss to a rank gap squared loss combined with a nonlinear tanh transform of advantage signals, encouraging larger margins with smooth gradients and emphasizing the magnitude of normalized advantage gaps.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(lpw, lpl)\nadv_gap = advantage_gap\nscaled_gap = tanh(adv_gap)\nloss = weight * (rank_gap * scaled_gap) ** 2\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_rank_gap",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh_squared",
    "agg_family": "mean",

  },

  ],

    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",

      "advantage_gap"
    ],

    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    rg = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)\n    scaled_adv = ops.tanh(adv_gap)\n    loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.pow(ops.mul(rg, scaled_adv), 2))\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "name": "loss_contrastive_001_advantage",
  "intuition": "Use a contrastive paradigm with advantage signals to encourage higher margin between preferred and non-preferred sequences, applying a softplus on negative advantage-weighted log probability gaps to create a smooth, hinge-like penalty emphasizing confident ranking with margin.",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    margin = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), adv_gap)\n    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(margin)), weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)"

{
  "name": "loss_rankgap_weighted_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based logsigmoid losses to a rank-gap-based loss that uses a bounded nonlinearity (tanh) on advantage signal, emphasizing robust rank correlation penalization weighted by the pair importance.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(advantage_w - advantage_l)\nweighted_score = tanh(alpha * (advantage_w - advantage_l)) * weight\nloss = mean(weighted_score * rank_gap)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    gap = adv_w - adv_l\n    rank_g = ops.rank_gap(gap)\n    tanh_score = ops.tanh(ops.mul(alpha, gap))\n    weighted = ops.mul(tanh_score, weight)\n    loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(weighted, rank_g))\n    return loss"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    beta = 0.1\n    x = alpha * scale * ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    x = ops.sub(x, ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_margin_smooth_hinge_advantage",
  "intuition": "A pairwise margin loss using a smoothed hinge formulation that softly penalizes differences in log probabilities weighted by advantage gap, encouraging margin maximization with a continuous penalty instead of a hard cutoff.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = lpw - lpl\nadv = advantage_gap\nscaled_margin = alpha * margin\nhinge_loss = max(0, 1 - scaled_margin)\nsmooth_loss = hinge_loss * hinge_loss\nloss = mean(weight * adv * smooth_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin_smoothhinge",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "hinge_squared",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "max",
    "mul",
    "mean"
  ],

    "expects": [

      "log_prob_l",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)  # lpw - lpl\n    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)\n    hinge = ops.max(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(scaled_margin), scaled_margin), ops.zeros_like(scaled_margin))  # max(0, 1 - scaled_margin)\n    smooth_loss = ops.mul(hinge, hinge)  # squared hinge\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(smooth_loss, adv_gap)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}

    # Combine losses

    # Apply optional weighting
    if weight is not None:
        combined_loss = combined_loss * weight

    # Return mean loss over batch

  "intuition": "This loss shifts from pairwise margin or log-sigmoid paradigms to a contrastive paradigm using a tanh-based similarity measure between log-probability differences weighted by the sum of advantages, emphasizing smooth preference learning by pushing similar preferences closer and opposing dissimilar ones further apart with soft gradients.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_sum = advantage_w + advantage_l\nscore = tanh(alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))\nloss = (1 - score) * adv_sum * weight\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {

    "agg_family": "mean",

      "log_prob_l",

      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))\n    adv_sum = ops.add(adv_w, adv_l)\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    score = ops.tanh(ops.mul(alpha, diff))\n    loss = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(score), score), adv_sum)\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_contrastive_diff_advantage_exp_scaled",
  "intuition": "Transforms the pairwise preference problem into a contrastive loss that compares exponentiated scaled log-probability differences weighted by the advantage gap. Instead of margin or ranking losses, it enforces a softmax-like competition between winning and losing pairs using a contrastive paradigm with exponential link and normalized aggregation.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nscaled_diff = alpha * diff * advantage_gap\nexp_w = exp(scaled_diff)\nexp_l = exp(-scaled_diff)\nloss_i = -log( exp_w / (exp_w + exp_l) ) * weight_i\nfinal_loss = sum(loss) / sum(weight)",

    "sum"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {

      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    scaled_diff = ops.mul(ops.mul(alpha, diff), advantage_gap)\n    exp_w = ops.exp(scaled_diff)\n    exp_l = ops.exp(ops.neg(scaled_diff))\n    denominator = ops.add(exp_w, exp_l)\n    probs = ops.div(exp_w, denominator)\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.mul(ops.log(probs), weight))\n    total_weight = ops.clamp(ops.sum(weight), 1e-8, 1e8)\n    return ops.div(ops.sum(loss), total_weight)"
}
